caption: The drawing depicts a single, intricately designed object resembling an ornate iron trivet or decorative escutcheon, rendered in shades of brown and dark gray to black. The object has a symmetrical composition with a central shield-like shape that is framed by a raised, curly border. At the top center, there is a prominent, openwork heart shape. Below the heart, a starburst or floral motif with multiple pointed rays or petals is set in the middle of the upper shield area. Two textured, twisted rope-like elements run down the sides from the upper corners and curve inward. The lower portion of the shield features a shell-like pattern with ribbed lines radiating upward and outward. The rendering emphasizes the metallic texture and aged patina of the object, with shadows and highlights that suggest dimensionality. The drawing is signed at the bottom right with the name "Austin Davison II." The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the object.
title: Cast Iron Stand
